title: 04_severe_mechanism_co_svr
interpretation: The two reach MAP≈70 mmHg by different routes: the engine collapses via cardiac-output failure with near-constant SVR (hypodynamic/low-output shock), while the extraction holds output and swings SVR — vasoconstriction then sympathetic-fatigue vasodilation (hyperdynamic/warm shock). The extraction's single AIR→sympathetic arc overshoots the vasomotor response the engine's full cardiovascular control keeps muted.
